name: Telemetry: Cost
description: Pure-code telemetry evaluator returning the agent estimated dollar cost from AgenticTelemetry. Lower is better; pass when within budget. A cost that was not tracked (EstimatedCostUsd null) is not measured: the result is skipped, never scored as $0.

expectedInputs.description: AgenticTelemetry record with EstimatedCostUsd (null when the cost was not tracked).
